title: Buddhist Mahayana Texts, incl. Heart Sutra (SBE 49)
author: Max Muller (trans)
description: Buddhist Mahayana Texts, Volume XLIX of The Sacred Books of the East (Oxford, 1894), edited by F. Max Müller. Part I is the Buddhacarita of Ashvaghosha, the first-century epic poem on the life of the Buddha, translated from Sanskrit by E. B. Cowell. Part II contains the Larger and Smaller Sukhavativyuha Sutras, describing Amitabha Buddha's Pure Land of Bliss, together with the Vajracchedika (Diamond Sutra) and the Larger and Smaller Prajnaparamita-hridaya Sutras (the Heart Sutra), translated by Max Müller. Part III gives the Amitayur-dhyana Sutra, the meditation on the Buddha of Infinite Life, translated from the Chinese by J. Takakusu. These texts are foundational for Mahayana teaching on emptiness and the perfection of wisdom, for the life of the Buddha, and for Pure Land devotion across East Asia.
